<script id="wa-firstpaint-515">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  try {
    var query=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    var hash=(location.hash||'').toLowerCase();
    // Preserve direct links and emergency original/full page modes.
    if(query.has('wa59_original')||query.has('wa57_all')||
       (hash&&!/^(#home|#top|#wahome|#xhome|#wa50home)$/.test(hash))) return;
    var root=document.documentElement;
    root.classList.add('wa-firstpaint-pending');
    var finished=false, observer=null, timer=null;
    function unlock(reason){
      if(finished)return;
      finished=true;
      if(observer)observer.disconnect();
      if(timer)clearTimeout(timer);
      root.classList.remove('wa-firstpaint-pending');
      root.setAttribute('data-wa-firstpaint',reason);
    }
    function check(){
      if(finished||!root.classList.contains('wa59-ready')||
         !root.classList.contains('wa57-focused')||
         !document.querySelector('#xHome .wa59-landing .wa510-hero, #wa50Home .wa59-landing .wa510-hero'))return;
      // The stylesheet links are in HEAD: layout is finalized before reveal.
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){unlock('ready')})});
    }
    observer=new MutationObserver(check);
    observer.observe(root,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',check,{once:true});
    // Fail OPEN if optional 5.x modules are unavailable (offline / error).
    timer=setTimeout(function(){unlock('fallback')},7000);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide',function(){unlock('pagehide')},{once:true});
    window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(e){if(e.persisted)unlock('bfcache')});
  }catch(e){document.documentElement.classList.remove('wa-firstpaint-pending')}
})();
</script>

html.wa-firstpaint-pending { background: #080913 !important }
html.wa-firstpaint-pending body { visibility: hidden !important; pointer-events: none !important }
html.wa-firstpaint-pending::before {
  content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483646;
  background: #080913;
}
html.wa-firstpaint-pending::after {
  content: 'WAV ARCHIVE'; position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; top: 48%;
  transform: translateY(-50%); z-index: 2147483647;
  color: #f4f0ff; text-align: center; letter-spacing: .17em;
  font: 700 clamp(17px, 4.1vw, 24px)/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif;
}
</style>
